args.question: The design team standardized on a monitor model for new design hires. Our catalog has two new, in-stock options: MN-27 (27-inch 4K, $329) and MN-32 (32-inch 5K, $529). Which one is the design team's standard? I'll include 3 units of it (along with 3× DK-200 docks to HQ) in a single PO.

Order placed successfully. Here's the summary:

**Purchase Order PO0001 — placed, shipped to HQ**
- 3× USB-C Dock **DK-200** (new) @ $189 = $567
